Model	STI-050FE
Product Name	5 port 10/100Mbps Industrial Ethernet Switch
Fixed Port	4*10/100M RJ45 port / 1*10/100M Uplink RJ45 port
Bandwidth	1Gbps
Packet Forwarding	0.74Mpps
MAC	1K
Buffer	768K
LED Indicator	PW: power indicator (green) / Uplink port: 10/100M connection indicator light / Port: green _10M network connection indicator / green+orange _100M network connection indicator / V1: Main power indicator (green) / V2: slave power indicator (green)
Power	Three groups of independent power input / SW: DC 12-57V
Operating Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+75°C / 10%～90% RH No condensation
Storage Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+85°C / 5%～95% RH No condensation
Dimension / L*W*H	Device: 105mm*90mm*36mm / Packing Box: 200mm*130mm*40mm
N.W/G.W(Kg)	0.5Kg/0.6Kg
Lightning / Protection level	6KV 8/20us, 8KV ESD electrostatic protection / IP40
Installation	Desktop, Wall, Rack mountable(with mounting hangers)
Certificate	CE-EMC EN55032; CE-LVD EN62368 / FCC Part 15Class B; RoHS
Warranty	3 Years
